name: Brown County Farmers' Markets
tagline: Brown's Family Farm Market – Family owned and operated for over 31 Years!
description: Brown County Farmers' Markets is a farmers market in 7389 Clifton Ave., OH, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
